info.name: Programs resource (local)
info.description: Tests the Programs resource: create, list, get, update, delete, undelete, the module manifest, what the admin builds on a leaf (a rule or typed settings, including library-backed ones), and the error cases. Needs the HTTP server on {{base_url}} (default http://localhost:8090) and, for the library settings, global-settings running with a library whose id is in {{library_id}}. Run top to bottom; each folder deletes its own test program. Requirements, Approval steps, Applications and Signoffs are parked (features.enrollment_review = false, the default): their requests live in enrollment-review.postman_collection.json, and the "Parked modules" folder here checks they are really off.

item.name: The main modules (the left list of Create Program)

exec: pm.test('Overview is the only one the admin cannot pick: hide it from the list',()=>{const pick=j.results.filter(r=>r.selectable).map(r=>r.name);pm.expect(pick).to.eql(['Catalog & Pricing','Enrollment','Document & Agreements','Order & Transaction','Configuration & Oversight']);const o=j.results[0];pm.expect(o.source).to.eql('default');pm.expect(o.selectable).to.eql(false);pm.expect(o.universal).to.eql(true);});

pm.test('each row has what the screen needs',()=>j.results.forEach(r=>{['id','key','name','kind','parent_id','ancestry','position','source','selectable','path'].forEach(k=>pm.expect(r).to.have.property(k));}));

exec: pm.test('premade leaf with its handler and api',()=>{pm.expect(j.kind).to.eql('leaf');pm.expect(j.source).to.eql('premade');pm.expect(j.handler_key).to.eql('enrolled_stores');pm.expect(j.api_base).to.eql('enrollments');pm.expect(j.ui_component).to.eql('custom:enrolled_stores');pm.expect(j.selectable).to.eql(true);pm.expect(j.allow_components).to.eql(true);pm.expect(j.ancestry).to.eql(j.key);});

item.name: Page 3: the last, with no further token
A page size above the cap is capped, not refused
THE WHOLE TREE in one call (load Create Program once)

exec: pm.test('a real tree: at least 67 modules, every parent_id points at its parent, every ancestry equals its key',()=>{pm.expect(all.length).to.be.at.least(67);all.forEach(([n,p])=>{pm.expect(n.parent_id).to.eql(p?p.id:null);pm.expect(n.ancestry).to.eql(n.key);});});

item.name: Programs
item.description: Run top to bottom. A fresh slug is generated on the first run; 'Reset' clears it.

request.description: One transaction: program + picked modules (with ancestors) + Overview + counters + audit + outbox.

exec: pm.test('premade modules carry handler and api_base', () => { const a = b.modules.find(m => m.key === 'enrollment.stores.enrolled_stores_control_panel'); pm.expect(a.source).to.eql('premade'); pm.expect(a.handler_key).to.eql('enrolled_stores'); pm.expect(a.api_base).to.eql('enrollments'); });
// The list is oldest first and test programs pile up, so follow the page tokens until the new program is found.
const wanted = pm.collectionVariables.get('slug'); const base = pm.collectionVariables.get('base_url');
if (!page.next_page_token) return done(new Error('program ' + wanted + ' is not in the list'));
pm.sendRequest(base + '/programs?max_page_size=200&page_token=' + page.next_page_token, (err, res) => err ? done(err) : look(res.json()));
pm.test('every module has source and api_base for premade', () => r.filter(m => m.source === 'premade').forEach(m => pm.expect(m.api_base).to.be.a('string')));
pm.test('mode is null until the admin chooses Rule or Settings', () => r.forEach(m => pm.expect(m.mode).to.eql(null)));
// Deleted programs pile up and the list is oldest first: follow the page tokens until ours is found.
const wanted = pm.collectionVariables.get('program_id'); const base = pm.collectionVariables.get('base_url');
pm.test('deleted program listed with state DELETED', function (done) {
if (found) { try { pm.expect(found.state).to.eql('DELETED'); return done(); } catch (e) { return done(e); } }
if (!page.next_page_token) return done(new Error('the deleted program is not in the list'));
pm.sendRequest(base + '/programs?show_deleted=true&max_page_size=200&page_token=' + page.next_page_token, (err, res) => err ? done(err) : look(res.json()));

item.name: Settings and rules
item.description: What the admin builds on a leaf: a RULE (the frontend renders the rule engine) or SETTINGS (a name and a type each: boolean = Yes/No, number, text, radio, checkbox, dropdown). Library-backed settings read their options from global-settings, so {{library_id}} must be a library that exists there. Run top to bottom; the last request deletes the test program.

item.name: 1. Create: a rule leaf + a settings leaf with every type

request.description: Pre Enrollment becomes a RULE leaf. Warranty becomes a SETTINGS leaf: boolean (Yes/No), number, text, radio with its own options, a dropdown fed ONLY by a global-settings library, and a dropdown with the admin's own values.

exec: pm.test('Pre Enrollment is a rule leaf (frontend renders the rule engine)', () => { pm.expect(pre.mode).to.eql('rule'); pm.expect(pre.rule).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(pre).to.not.have.property('settings'); });
pm.test('Warranty is a settings leaf with 6 settings, in order', () => pm.expect(w.settings.map(s => s.name)).to.eql(['Warranty enabled','Max days','Notes','Grade','Coverage','Region']));

pm.test('each type says which control to draw', () => pm.expect([by['Warranty enabled'].render, by['Max days'].render, by['Notes'].render, by['Grade'].render, by['Coverage'].render]).to.eql(['yes_no','number_input','text_input','radio_group','dropdown']));

pm.test('defaults and required are kept', () => { pm.expect(by['Warranty enabled'].default).to.eql(true); pm.expect(by['Max days'].default).to.eql(90); pm.expect(by['Max days'].required).to.eql(true); pm.expect(by['Grade'].default).to.eql('a'); });
pm.test('manual radio: own options, source manual', () => { pm.expect(by['Grade'].options_source).to.eql('manual'); pm.expect(by['Grade'].options.map(o => o.code)).to.eql(['a','b','c']); });
pm.test('manual dropdown: explicit code kept, the other derived from the label', () => pm.expect(by['Region'].options.map(o => o.code)).to.eql(['north_america','eu']));

pm.test('library dropdown: the LIBRARY is the source of the options', () => { pm.expect(by['Coverage'].options_source).to.eql('library'); pm.expect(by['Coverage'].library_id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('library_id') || pm.collectionVariables.get('library_id')); pm.expect(by['Coverage'].library_error).to.eql(null); pm.expect(by['Coverage'].options.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(by['Coverage'].options.every(o => o.source === 'library')).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('boolean / number / text have no options and no source', () => ['Warranty enabled','Max days','Notes'].forEach(n => { pm.expect(by[n].options).to.eql([]); pm.expect(by[n].options_source).to.eql(null); }));

item.name: 2. Manifest: the same, read back (library options from memory)

exec: pm.test('settings come back with their options', () => { pm.expect(w.settings.length).to.eql(6); pm.expect(w.settings.find(s => s.name === 'Coverage').options.length).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test('only configurable leaves carry a mode', () => r.filter(m => m.mode).forEach(m => pm.expect(m.allow_components).to.eql(true)));
pm.test('under a few seconds even with a library', () => pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000));
pm.test('manual options still there', () => pm.expect(w.settings.find(s => s.name === 'Grade').options.length).to.eql(3));

item.name: Setting values
item.description: What admins enter into the settings they defined. Boolean / number / text settings take a `value`; radio / checkbox / dropdown settings take `option_ids`. The whole page is saved in ONE request and ONE transaction, with the `version` you last read (a stale one is a 409). Needs {{library_id}} (see the folder before).

item.name: 0. Create a program with settings of every kind

exec: const w = pm.response.json().modules.find(m => m.key === 'catalog_pricing.products_rules.warranty'); const by = Object.fromEntries(w.settings.map(s => [s.name, s]));

pm.collectionVariables.set('vopts', JSON.stringify({ gradeA: by['Grade'].options[0].id, gradeB: by['Grade'].options[1].id, europe: by['Region'].options[1].id, naRegion: by['Region'].options[0].id, coverage: by['Coverage'].options[0].id }));
pm.test('six settings, nothing saved yet', () => { pm.expect(w.settings.length).to.eql(6); pm.expect(w.settings.every(s => s.value === null && s.option_ids.length === 0)).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('empty, with the version to send back', () => { pm.expect(b.results).to.eql([]); pm.expect(String(b.version)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('vversion')); });

item.name: 2. Save a value of every type, in one request

exec: const v = { values: { [ids['Enabled']]: { value: true }, [ids['Max days']]: { value: 90 }, [ids['Notes']]: { value: 'hello' }, [ids['Grade']]: { option_ids: [opt.gradeB] }, [ids['Coverage']]: { option_ids: [opt.coverage] }, [ids['Region']]: { option_ids: [opt.europe] } } };
const body = { values: v.values }; if (v.version !== false) { body.version = (v.version !== undefined) ? v.version : Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('vversion')); }
pm.test('6 values changed, the version moved up by one', () => { pm.expect(b.changed).to.eql(6); pm.expect(b.version).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('vversion')) + 1); });
pm.test('plain values keep their JSON value', () => { pm.expect(by['Enabled'].value).to.eql(true); pm.expect(by['Max days'].value).to.eql(90); pm.expect(by['Notes'].value).to.eql('hello'); });

request.description: Boolean/number/text take `value`; radio/checkbox/dropdown take `option_ids`. The version you read is checked, the whole page is validated, and nothing is saved if any value is wrong.

item.name: 3. The manifest shows the values next to each setting

exec: const w = pm.response.json().results.find(m => m.key === 'catalog_pricing.products_rules.warranty'); const by = Object.fromEntries(w.settings.map(s => [s.name, s]));

pm.test('plain values and choices are on the settings', () => { pm.expect(by['Enabled'].value).to.eql(true); pm.expect(by['Max days'].value).to.eql(90); pm.expect(by['Grade'].option_ids.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(by['Region'].option_ids.length).to.eql(1); });

item.name: 4. Save the same values again: nothing changes

exec: const v = { values: { [ids['Enabled']]: { value: true }, [ids['Max days']]: { value: 90 } } };
const body = { values: v.values }; if (v.version !== false) { body.version = (v.version !== undefined) ? v.version : Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('vversion')); }
pm.test('changed 0, version NOT bumped (no false "unpublished changes")', () => { pm.expect(b.changed).to.eql(0); pm.expect(String(b.version)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('vversion')); });

item.name: 5. A stale version is a conflict (409)

exec: const v = { version: Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('vversion')) - 1, values: { [ids['Enabled']]: { value: false } } };
const body = { values: v.values }; if (v.version !== false) { body.version = (v.version !== undefined) ? v.version : Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('vversion')); }

request.description: Someone else saved since you loaded the page.

item.name: 6. Clear values (null, and an empty choice)

exec: const body = { values: v.values }; if (v.version !== false) { body.version = (v.version !== undefined) ? v.version : Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('vversion')); }

pm.test('2 cleared and gone from the list', () => { pm.expect(b.changed).to.eql(2); pm.expect(b.results.map(r => r.name)).to.not.include.members(['Notes']); pm.expect(b.results.map(r => r.name)).to.not.include.members(['Region']); });

item.name: 7. Save without a version: no check (last write wins)

exec: const v = { version: false, values: { [ids['Enabled']]: { value: false } } };
const body = { values: v.values }; if (v.version !== false) { body.version = (v.version !== undefined) ? v.version : Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('vversion')); }

const v = { version: false, values: { [ids['Grade']]: { option_ids: [opt.gradeB] } } };
